text_devanagari: अहा॒ अरा॑ति॒मवि॑दः स्यो॒नमप्यभूर्भ॒द्रे सु॑कृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के । ए॒वाहं॰ । ॰ ॥ ७ ॥
notes: Worked at 5-8x on a stitched full-line image (two segments overlap by 91 px; line width 3045 px). Band separation on the ink profile is clean: line-above bodies end y~45 with their anudatta bars at y~60-80; this line's svarita strokes occupy y~92-127, headline y~130-140, bodies to y~215; this line's anudatta bars occupy y~229-252; the line below's svaritas start y~265. All seven bars I report are isolated connected components 33-36 px wide and 8-11 px tall lying wholly in the y 229-252 band, so attribution to the middle line is unambiguous; magnification was more than sufficient. Anudatta positions (bar centre -> akshara): 447 -> हा of अहा; 796 -> त of ति; 1219 -> स्यो; 1627 -> र्भ; 1855 -> कृ; 2136 -> लो; 2394 -> ए. Rejected false positives, each checked individually: (1) the tall vertical at x1461-1500 above प्य has ink in every row from y0 down to the headline, i.e. it is a continuous descender belonging to the line above, not a svarita; (2) the 32 px curved hook at x1595-1626 is the repha of र्भ; (3) the 18 px round blob at x2583-2600 is the anusvara of हं; (4) the wide hooks at x738-792, 920-975, 1205-1261, 1644-1696, 2137-2193, 2214-2263 are i/o/e matras; (5) the shape at x1771-1804 in the lower band is not an isolated component - it is the bottom of the u-matra loop of सु, so सु carries no anudatta; (6) under कृ the vocalic-ri hook and a genuine separate bar both occur, and only the bar (x1838-1872) is counted. Two placement calls worth flagging: the bar at 1610-1645 sits entirely to the right of भू (which ends at 1603) and under the left half of भ (1613-1669), so I assign it to र्भ, not to भू; and the bar at 1202-1236 sits near the centre of the स्यो cluster (1138-1277) and is assigned to स्यो. The four svaritas are narrow strokes 9-10 px wide standing free above the headline at x662-671 (over रा), x994-1002 (over व of वि), x1788-1797 (over स of सु), x2040-2048 (over the stem of स्य). Reading note: at low magnification the stroke at x994-1002 looks like an anusvara, but at 8x it is a straight vertical of svarita height and shape, and there is no dot - the word is मविदः, not मविंदः. The final numeral is read as ७; its bowl opens left with the tail hooking to the lower left, and it has no right-hand descender, which rules out ९.
